text:
- **Codex auto mode:** pm init now turns on Codex auto mode in the repo's tracked config file. pm doctor also names a host where the Codex sandbox cannot start.
- **Site and session modes:** The site now serves on networks without Cloudflare, and agent questions can be answered there. Sessions can run in interactive or autopilot mode, which turns off the owner-request judge.
- **Search and design pages:** pm search finds earlier sprints, decisions and design sections by topic. A new search design page sets when an index is needed, based on measured growth.
- **Command grammar and tests:** Every command now takes the same scope flags, and one verb closes a need. Harness date checks read a pinned clock, so runs that cross midnight pass.
